question: ABHL is related to FFMP in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, URBB is related to ZVGF. To which of the given options is JDQN related, following the same logic?10119
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fe2f5f356a9438cd1812c5b46a5a7f6d2ce2d22f52d7d517a26bc42ad53d80d9.png] Logic followed here is: The letters in the first word are shifted by +5 and +4 alternatively to get the corresponding letters in the second word based on their positional values in the English alphabetical order. **For** **ABHL is related to FFMP →**
